entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Fereydoon Hoveyda was an Iranian diplomat, writer and thinker. He was the Iranian ambassador to the United Nations from 1971 until 1979. He was the younger brother of the 37th prime minister of Iran, Amir-Abbas Hoveyda.
